subject: Civil Engineering
title: Highway Safety Features
description: A quick, practical guide to Highway Safety Features.

hook.text: A car drifts off the road at 70 mph. The guardrail saves the occupants' lives.

buildup.text: W-beam guardrails deflect vehicles back to the road. Cable barriers flex and absorb impact.

discovery.text: Crash attenuators at gore points cushion impacts with sand barrels or crushable cartridges.

twist.text: Rumble strips alert drowsy drivers by vibration — simple grooves save thousands of lives.

climax.text: Clear zones keep the roadside free of rigid objects — 30 feet of forgiveness.

punchline.text: Highways assume drivers will make mistakes. The road forgives them.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of a clear zone alongside a highway?
options: To provide space for future lane expansion
To keep the roadside free of rigid objects so errant vehicles can recover safely
To allow wildlife to cross the highway without obstruction

details.summary: Highway safety features include guardrails, cable barriers, crash cushions, rumble strips, breakaway sign posts, and clear zones designed to reduce the severity of crashes when vehicles leave the roadway.
details.whyItMatters: Roadside safety hardware prevents thousands of fatalities annually. Run-off-road crashes account for nearly half of all highway fatalities, making roadside protection a critical engineering priority.
takeaways: W-beam guardrails redirect vehicles and absorb energy through controlled deformation
Clear zones of 9-14 meters allow errant drivers to recover without hitting objects
Rumble strips reduce run-off-road crashes by 15-70% depending on type and location

faq.question: How do cable median barriers prevent crossover crashes?
faq.answer: High-tension cable barriers catch errant vehicles using flexible steel cables on weak posts that absorb energy through cable tension and post deflection. They allow 2-4 meters of deflection, which requires adequate median width, but are highly effective at preventing deadly head-on collisions.

faq.question: What makes a sign post or light pole breakaway?
faq.answer: Breakaway supports use weakened bases, slip connections, or frangible couplings that fracture on vehicle impact. The pole breaks away, flies over the vehicle, and the vehicle passes through without severe deceleration. This converts a potentially fatal impact into a minor incident.
